name: fastlink
description: FastLink helper: drives your own Chrome (page snapshots, clicks, form fills, batch automation) through the FastLink relay. Pair this machine once with `node server/index.js pair <CODE>` (code from https://relay.ytx.app/pair/new).

tools.name: fast_status
tools.description: Which browsers are paired to your FastLink account, which are online, and which one this session drives.

tools.name: fast_profile
tools.description: Choose which browser this session drives, by name, or "auto" for your default browser.

tools.name: fast_snapshot
tools.description: Snapshot of this session's Chrome tab.

tools.name: fast_click
tools.description: Click an element matching text/label/aria-label/placeholder.

tools.name: fast_fill
tools.description: Fill input/textarea/contenteditable by label/placeholder/name.

tools.name: fast_tab
tools.description: Open a new Chrome tab at the given URL.

tools.name: fast_nav
tools.description: Navigate this session's Chrome tab to a URL.

tools.name: fast_list
tools.description: List the open tabs with id, url, title, and active state.

tools.name: fast_switch
tools.description: Switch focus to a specific Chrome tab.

tools.name: fast_wait
tools.description: Wait for the page to reach a state.

tools.name: fast_evaluate
tools.description: Escape hatch: run JavaScript in this session's Chrome tab.

tools.name: fast_frame_read
tools.description: Read labelled field values inside a cross-origin frame.

tools.name: fast_text
tools.description: Read text (or HTML) from this session's Chrome tab.

tools.name: fast_select_option
tools.description: Pick an option from a dropdown/combobox/select.

tools.name: fast_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of this session's Chrome tab.

tools.name: fast_key_press
tools.description: Press a single key on this session's tab.

tools.name: fast_scroll
tools.description: Scroll this session's tab.

tools.name: fast_close
tools.description: Close a Chrome tab by id (from fast_list) or by URL/title substring match.

tools.name: fast_batch
tools.description: Run multiple FastLink actions in sequence with ONE tool call.

tools.name: fast_click_xy

tools.name: fast_type
tools.description: Trusted typing into whatever element currently has focus, via CDP Input.insertText — React/LWC accept it because it's a real input event (unlike setting .val...

tools.name: fast_feedback
tools.description: Send a bug report or idea to the FastLink team.
